findings.evidenceJa: ダンダンと豪快にたらを切る
findings.governingReading: I chop vigorously through the cod—thump, thump
findings.explanation: Shirou’s energetic knife rhythm and force disappear from the plain statement of cutting fish.

findings.evidenceJa: だしとった鍋
findings.governingReading: the pot of prepared dashi stock
findings.explanation: A prepared stock central to Shirou’s hot-pot cooking becomes generic soup.

findings.evidenceJa: 人数分の食器
findings.governingReading: enough tableware for everyone
findings.explanation: All required dishes and utensils become plates alone.

findings.highlight: it’s so cold that it started snowing
findings.evidenceJa: 寒い寒い、雪降ってきた
findings.governingReading: Cold, cold—the snow has started falling
findings.explanation: Two observations are converted into a direct causal claim that cold temperature made the snow begin.

findings.highlight: There’s commotion as Fuji-nee comes home
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃーす、とばかりに藤ねえが帰ってきた
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee comes home with the air of a breezy “Hey, all”
findings.explanation: A characterization of Taiga’s casual entrance becomes unsupported noise or disturbance.

findings.evidenceJa: 鍋物だ
findings.governingReading: hot pot tonight
findings.explanation: A familiar dish category becomes unnatural “pot food.”

findings.evidenceJa: お邪魔しています
findings.governingReading: Thank you for having me / Excuse my intrusion
findings.explanation: Rin’s polite acknowledgment that she is visiting Taiga’s household becomes a generic greeting, weakening the later argument over her presence.

findings.evidenceJa: 雪身のたら
findings.governingReading: snow-season cod / “snow-bodied” cod
findings.explanation: The source’s snow-linked culinary expression is asserted to mean white cod without support from the text, erasing its seasonal echo with the snowfall.

findings.evidenceJa: お気に入りのバームクーヘン
findings.governingReading: her favorite Baumkuchen
findings.explanation: Taiga’s specific favorite cake disappears, weakening the deliberately prolonged beat before she notices Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: モムモムとつまんだ
findings.governingReading: nibbles and munches away at it—mom-mom
findings.explanation: The comic sound and small picking motion are reduced to generic eating.

findings.evidenceJa: バームクーヘンをごくんと飲み込んで
findings.governingReading: gulping down the Baumkuchen
findings.explanation: The named food is again generalized at the physical punch line where Taiga swallows it before charging back.

findings.evidenceJa: 帝国軍
findings.governingReading: the Imperial Army—read “Tōsaka”
findings.explanation: The written image of an imperial army advancing and counterattacking under the Tōsaka ruby becomes an ordinary personal army.

findings.evidenceJa: 残念ですが
findings.governingReading: Unfortunately, I cannot answer that
findings.explanation: Rin’s faux-regretful politeness disappears, and the closing “I wish it is as you imagine” is grammatically malformed.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつにあの笑顔をされると気圧される
findings.governingReading: When she gives me that smile, I feel overawed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s personal familiarity with Rin’s intimidating smile becomes a generic second-person observation.

findings.highlight: The snow stops before the pot is empty
findings.evidenceJa: 鍋がカラになる頃、外の雪も止んでいた
findings.governingReading: By around the time the pot was empty, the snow outside had stopped as well
findings.explanation: A loose simultaneity connecting dinner’s end and the snowfall’s end becomes a strict claim that snow stops first.

findings.highlight: there’s only a bit of snow out there
findings.evidenceJa: 庭にはかすかな雪しか残っていないだろう
findings.governingReading: there is probably only a faint covering of snow left in the garden
findings.explanation: The specific garden, visible residue, and tentative inference are generalized to an unspecified outside.

findings.evidenceJa: この程度の感覚のズレ
findings.governingReading: a sensory mismatch this slight
findings.explanation: Shirou’s precise recognition that proprioception is misaligned becomes a vague “problem.”

findings.highlight: I put a towel below me
findings.evidenceJa: 床にバスタオルを敷いた
findings.governingReading: I spread a bath towel over the floor
findings.explanation: The protective towel’s concrete placement beneath the dishes becomes placement beneath Shirou himself.

findings.evidenceJa: 割れてはいない
findings.governingReading: fortunately, none of them has broken
findings.explanation: The statement that the dropped plates remain unbroken is attached to a singular, unclear “it,” obscuring the drop-versus-break count.

findings.evidenceJa: 矢のようなつっこみ
findings.governingReading: Taiga fires back with an arrow-sharp retort
findings.explanation: The speed and sharpness of Taiga’s comic interjection disappear.

findings.highlight: if she watches me and distracts me
findings.evidenceJa: そう真面目に見られると気が散って
findings.governingReading: being watched with such seriousness breaks my concentration
findings.explanation: Rin’s grave manner causes Shirou’s distraction; the English makes her an active distracting agent and omits the seriousness.

findings.highlight: I couldn’t move my left hand quickly enough
findings.evidenceJa: 左手が咄嗟に動いてくれなかった
findings.governingReading: my left hand would not move when I needed it to
findings.explanation: Complete failure of the hand to respond in the instant becomes merely slow movement.

findings.evidenceJa: ずかずかとこっちにやってきた
findings.governingReading: strides straight over toward me
findings.explanation: Rin’s abrupt, forceful approach after deciding to intervene becomes neutral movement.

findings.evidenceJa: さて
findings.governingReading: Now then—
findings.explanation: A transition into Shirou’s next decision becomes a dangling first-person subject.
